meta.description: Draw and export phylogenetic trees with Bio.Phylo plus matplotlib, and route rich figures to ggtree, ETE4, or iTOL.
meta.executed: 9/9 inputs executed (Biopython 1.88, matplotlib, pymupdf, R ggtree 3.14.0 / ggplot2 4.0.3 / treeio / ape); iTOL and FigTree not executed
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill: 7 pre-fix inputs as regression tests plus 2 new inputs (N = 9). Inputs 1-3 use the fixed Bio.Phylo recipes verbatim; Inputs 5-7 re-run the pre-fix auditor R scripts because the Skill still gives no ggtree patterns for those figures. SYNTHETIC data (data/make_data.py).

scientific_integrity.detail: Figures drawn from synthetic trees; no values altered.

methodological_ground.detail: Support measures named, PP not shown as bootstrap, no basal claim from unrooted layout.

code_usability.detail: All Bio.Phylo recipes and the three examples run; stated ggtree failures reproduce and the named fallbacks run.

functional_suitability.note: Dual-label support recipe, reroot warning, geom_range center, capped scale recipe and plain-Newick colour verified. The colour recipe calls common_ancestor on an unrooted IQ-TREE tree without rooting first and colours most of the tree (Input 2); the version block says gheatmap fails but it rendered here (Input 8). Rich-figure ggtree code still absent.
